{{Top}}
'''Stygian-triprismatic polymer''' was a harder form of [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]]. The mineral was used in many [[Armor/Legends|armors]] and shields, such as that worn by [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow stormtroopers]], and in some types of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]. It could also enhance portable [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth fields]] and [[Sound dampener/Legends|sound dampeners]] as well as being [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] resistant.
